text:
alex: heads up, integration CI is red on main — lots of failures in geoip-related tests, looks like the geoip-mock is returning 504s
ci-bot: Workflow: integrations/main (#742) failed — job: geoip-integ-tests — link: https://ci.example.com/runs/742 :x:
emily: seeing the same locally when pointing at ci-mocks: `curl http://ci-mock-geoip.internal/lookup?ip=1.1.1.1` -> 504, headers show upstream timeout
samir: any deploys to the mock infra in the last hour?
jin: pushed a config tweak to mock-router (~30m ago) to change upstream retries, rolling back now :wrench:
alex: can someone kick a rerun after rollback? we need a green to unblock the release branch
emily: log snippet from job (stacktrace):
```
ERROR lookup: upstream timeout after 2 attempts
2023-05-10T12:34:56Z geoip-mock handler error: 504 Gateway Timeout
```
jin: rollback applied to mock-router and restarted. health check shows /health OK but still 504s for some paths
samir: assigning a bisect: if rollback doesn't help can someone run the integration job with MOCK_GEOIP=local to narrow whether it's mock infra vs test change?
alex: good call. @qa can you run `./ci rerun --job geoip-integ-tests --env MOCK_GEOIP=local` and paste run id
qa: kicked rerun, run id 742-2 — starting now :rocket:
ci-bot: Run 742-2 started — monitoring logs
emily: while that's running, I bisected newest changes in tests — nothing obvious, but there was a mock dependency bump in package.json (geoip-mock v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0) in #739
samir: if the rerun with MOCK_GEOIP=local passes, we can suspect the hosted mock upgrade; if it still fails, likely test/tooling change
ci-bot: Run 742-2 completed — status: PASSED :white_check_mark:
alex: ok that pretty much nails it to the hosted mock. thanks @qa and @jin for quick rollback attempt
emily: filing a tiny rollback PR to pin geoip-mock to v1.4.2 in our CI images, will link the PR here
jin: I've opened an incident on infra side for the geoip mock provider — incident id INF-216, will update with root cause when available
samir: action items: (1) pin mock in CI images (emily) (2) patch hosted mock to handle retries gracefully (infra) (3) add integration fallback to MOCK_GEOIP=local in our test matrix for flaky runs (alex)
emily: PR: https://repo.example.com/redwood/ci-images/pulls/85 — pins v1.4.2, contains repro steps
alex: thanks all — I'm going to merge the pin once CI passes again, leaving this thread open until infra posts RCA
jin: INF-216 update: provider rolled back a bad deploy, they saw increased latency to the internal upstream causing 504s. provider will add circuit-breaker.
emily: merging PR now — will watch main CI
ci-bot: Merge triggered, new run 743 — monitoring
ci-bot: Run 743 completed — status: PASSED :white_check_mark:
alex: great, closing the loop. please add postmortem notes to INF-216 when available, otherwise we're unblocked for release. :tada:
